# SelectTreeViewNode <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Tree Views](BlitzPlus-Tree-Views)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SelectTreeViewNode:Void node:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a node. |

## Description

Selects a node, as if the user clicked it. There is no way to remove the selection afterwards other than selecting another node.
